      public SubjectIndexExtractor(DataField dataField, DataFieldKeyGenerator keyGenerator, String schemaAbbreviation)
      Creates a new instance of the SubjectIndexExtractor.
      Parameters:
      dataField - The data field to extract the key and values from.
      keyGenerator - The key generator to use. It is used all across the application to generate keys needed for indexing.
      schemaAbbreviation - The abbreviation of the source schema.

    • extract

      public void extract()
      Extracts the key and values from the data field. The key consists of two parts separated by an underscore:
      • Entry subfield ($a) key which is generated using the key generator provided in the constructor.
      • Schema abbreviation solarized using the Utils.solarize method.
